Let me apply the rule. Input has 3 at (r=2, c=0). So sr=8, sc=0, color=3.

For each (i,j): d = max(|i-8|, |j-0|) = max(8-i, j). on_seam = (j - i == sc - sr + 1) and (i < sr) = (j - i == 0 - 8 + 1 = -7) and (i < 8). So j - i == -7, i.e., j = i - 7. And i < 8.

For i from 0 to 7, j = i-7 ranges -7..0. Only j>=0 for i=7: j=0. So on_seam at (7,0).

Let me compute the whole grid.

d(i,j) = max(8-i, j).

color if d even (except seam flips).

Let me build 9x9.

i=0: 8-i=8. j=0: d=8 even -> color. j=1: d=8 even -> color. j=2..8: max(8,j). j=2 d=8 even color. ... j=8 d=8 even color. So row0: all 3? Wait j=1: max(8,1)=8 even. Yes all even. Row0 all 3.

Wait that seems odd. Let me check example: input 5 at (0,1). sr=0, sc=4. d = max(i, |j-4|). Output row0: 5,0,5,0,5,0,5,0,5. Check i=0,j=0: d=max(0,4)=4 even -> color 5. j=1: d=3 odd ->0. j=2: d=2 even->5. j=3: d=1 odd->0. j=4: d=0 even->5. j=5: d=1 odd->0... yes matches.

So for our case d=max(8-i, j). row0: d=8 all even, all color. Hmm.

i=1: 8-i=7. j=0: max(7,0)=7 odd->0. j=1:7 odd 0. j=2:7 odd 0... j=7:7 odd. j=8: max(7,8)=8 even->3. So row1: j0..7 =0, j8=3.

i=2: 8-i=6. j: max(6,j). j=0..5:6 even->3. j=6:6 even->3. Wait max(6,6)=6 even->3. j=7:7 odd->0. j=8:8 even->3. So row2: j0..6 =3, j7=0, j8=3.

Hmm wait j=0..6 all d=6 even. Yes.

i=3: 8-i=5. j=0..4: 5 odd->0. j=5: max(5,5)=5 odd 0. j=6:6 even 3. j=7:7 odd 0. j=8:8 even 3. Row3: j0..5=0, j6=3, j7=0, j8=3.

i=4: 8-i=4. j=0..3:4 even 3. j=4:4 even 3. j=5:5 odd 0. j=6:6 even 3. j=7:7 odd 0. j=8:8 even 3. Row4: j0..4=3, j5=0, j6=3, j7=0, j8=3.

i=5: 8-i=3. j=0:3 odd? max(3,0)=3 odd->0. j=1:3 odd 0. j=2:3 odd 0. j=3:3 odd 0. j=4:4 even 3. j=5:5 odd 0. j6:6 even 3. j7:7 odd 0. j8:8 even 3. Row5: j0..3=0,j4=3,j5=0,j6=3,j7=0,j8=3.

i=6: 8-i=2. j=0:2 even 3. j=1:2 even 3. j=2:2 even 3. j=3:3 odd 0. j4:4 even 3. j5:5 odd 0. j6:6 even 3. j7:7 odd 0. j8:8 even 3. Row6: 3,3,3,0,3,0,3,0,3.

i=7: 8-i=1. j=0: max(1,0)=1 odd. seam at (7,0): on_seam true. d=1 odd -> color if d%2==1 -> 3. So j0=3. j=1: d=1 odd, not seam ->0. j2:2 even 3. j3:3 odd 0. j4:4 even 3. j5:5 odd 0. j6:6 even 3. j7:7 odd 0. j8:8 even 3. Row7: 3,0,3,0,3,0,3,0,3.

i=8: 8-i=0. seam requires i<8, false. j=0: max(0,0)=0 even 3. j1:1 odd 0. j2:2 even 3. j3:3 odd 0. j4:4 even 3. j5:5 odd 0. j6:6 even 3. j7:7 odd 0. j8:8 even 3. Row8: 3,0,3,0,3,0,3,0,3.
